newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ROBERTO CARLOS SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH REAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBERTO CARLOS SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH REAL.

text.p: Real Madrid have reached terms with Roberto Carlos which will keep the set-piece specialist at the Spanish league champions until 2002, the club announced on Wednesday.
Under the contract, any club wanting to buy the Brazilian international will have to pay $100 (one hundred) million, the highest withdrawal clause in the history of the Spanish game.
Roberto Carlos' salary has not been disclosed, and he has not yet signed the contract as he is in Bolivia with Brazil at the Copa America tournament.
Real's international defender Rafael Alkorta said on Wednesday he would join Athletic Bilbao next season.
A tearful Alkorta told reporters he had decided to go home to the Basque country for personal reasons.
